# Open Data Actors

> 96 Apify actors that turn public data into clean tables, each with a free sample CSV. Built and maintained by the publisher.

## Actors
- [Local businesses with no website, from OpenStreetMap](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/local-business-leads.html): Businesses without a site are the warmest prospects for a website pitch.
- [New trucking companies, the week they get authority](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/fmcsa-new-carrier-leads.html): New carriers are the easiest buyers to win and the hardest to find: they appear in the FMCSA census before they appear on any lead list.
- [New LLCs and corporations by state](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/new-business-filings.html): New businesses need a bank, insurer and website in their first weeks.
- [Shopify store details: theme, apps, products](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/shopify-store-leads.html): Knowing which apps and theme a store uses tells you if they are a fit.
- [Emails and phones from a list of company websites](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/website-contact-extractor.html): Hunting for a contact page across hundreds of sites is slow.
- [Building permits and violations from US city portals](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/building-permits-leads.html): Permits tell you who is building before they hire a vendor.
- [Turn a list of domains into company profiles](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/company-enrichment-by-domain.html): You have domains but not names, socials, careers pages or contact channels.
- [Amazon product search results as a clean table](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/amazon-product-search.html): Amazon search and product pages are hard to turn into a table of prices, ratings and ASINs.
- [Google Maps scraper: places, ratings and details as a table](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/google-maps-places-scraper.html): Google Maps places by search and city: name, category, rating, review count, hours, website, closed flags and description. $1.50 per 1,000 places on the free plan, no subscription.
- [Amazon Best Sellers top 100 as a table, 21 countries](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/amazon-bestsellers.html): Amazon Best Sellers, New Releases, Movers & Shakers, Most Wished For and Gift Ideas ranks in 21 countries as one clean table: rank, ASIN, title, price, rating, reviews, images, category path.
- [LinkedIn company scraper: size, industry, followers and headquarters, no login](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/linkedin-company-scraper.html): Public LinkedIn company page data from a URL, slug, domain or name: industry, size, followers, headquarters, specialties. Real sample output and a same-input comparison.
- [Facebook pages scraper: followers, category and ad status without login](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/facebook-pages-scraper.html): Facebook pages scraper: Give public Facebook Page URLs. Each run returns one row per page: name, category, followers, website, social… $3 per 1,000 pages on the free plan.
- [Web design leads: local businesses with no or weak websites](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/website-redesign-leads.html): Web design leads: Give a business type and a city. The actor finds businesses on Google Maps, checks the website (missing, brok… $4 per 1,000 leads on the free plan.
- [YouTube sponsorship tracker: sponsors, promo codes and tracked links](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/youtube-sponsorship-tracker.html): YouTube sponsorship tracker: Give channels, videos or brand names. Each run returns one row per detected sponsorship: sponsor brand and do… $2 per 1,000 sponsorships on the free plan.
- [Google Maps new business radar: newly opened local businesses](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/google-maps-new-business-radar.html): Google Maps new business radar: Give a business type and a city. The actor finds listings that look new on Google Maps (few reviews, few phot… $3 per 1,000 new places on the free plan.
- [OpenStreetMap Business Leads: Find No-Website Leads](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/openstreetmap-business-leads.html): Export local businesses from OpenStreetMap with phone, website, business email and hours. Find businesses without a website. No API key. CSV, JSON.
- [FMCSA Insurance Cancellation Leads for Agents](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/fmcsa-insurance-cancellation-leads.html): Trucking insurance leads: carriers with FMCSA liability or cargo filings about to cancel, with contacts, fleet size and a lead score. No login.
- [Company Leadership Finder: Founders and Executives](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/decision-maker-finder.html): Get founders, executives and managers from a company's own team, about and leadership pages. Name, title, seniority, source link. No LinkedIn, no login.
- [Apollo Alternative for Local Businesses: Verified Emails](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/no-website-business-email-finder.html): Pay-as-you-go Apollo alternative for local leads: verified emails for small businesses, even with no website. No subscription. Pay per verified email.
- [City Event Organizer Leads: Emails, Phones, Venues](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/city-events-organizer-leads.html): Event organizer and venue leads with email, phone and website from official open city feeds: Paris, Nantes, Helsinki, New York. No login, no proxy.
- [Startups that just filed an SEC Form D](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/sec-form-d-funding-leads.html): Form D filings show who raised money, but EDGAR is hard to filter.
- [Federal grants and contract awards in one feed](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/federal-grants-contracts.html): Grants.gov and USAspending are separate sites with different filters.
- [Screen names against OFAC, EU, UN and UK lists](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/sanctions-screening.html): Manually searching lists for each new customer is slow.
- [WARN layoff notices from 7 states as clean rows](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/warn-layoff-alerts.html): WARN notices are public but live on seven different state sites in seven formats.
- [City council agenda items and votes, searchable data](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/city-council-agendas.html): Agenda items sit inside PDFs and portal pages city by city.
- [NPI Registry Scraper: New Healthcare Organizations](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/npi-new-provider-enrollment-monitor.html): Export new and changed NPI type 2 healthcare organizations from CMS NPPES with taxonomy, practice address and phone. No API key. CSV, JSON, Excel.
- [CFPB Complaints Scraper: Consumer Complaint Database](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/cfpb-consumer-complaints-monitor.html): Export and monitor CFPB consumer complaints by company, product, issue and state. New-only alerts and company trend summaries. No API key. CSV, JSON.
- [8-K Material Event Alerts: SEC 8-K Item Decoder](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/sec-edgar-filings-monitor.html): Alert on new SEC 8-K material events: items decoded to plain English, severity filter (high/medium/low), monitor mode. Official keyless EDGAR API.
- [H-1B Sponsor Employers: LCA Filings, Wages, Titles](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/h1b-lca-sponsor-employers.html): Find which US companies sponsor H-1B visas: LCA filings, certification rate, job titles, median wage and a sponsor score from DOL data. No login.
- [Business Entity Search: KYB Name Match, 6 State Registries](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/business-entity-search.html): Bulk-verify company names against official Secretary of State registry data in CO, NY, OR, CT, PA, TX. Status, agent, officers, match score.
- [Contractor License Lookup and Verification API (6 States)](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/contractor-license-lookup.html): Look up and verify contractor licenses in WA, TX, CT, CO, OR and DE from official state data. Status, expiry, trade, new licenses.
- [Open Payments Scraper: CMS Doctor Payments from Pharma](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/medicare-open-payments-doctors.html): Search CMS Open Payments for doctor payments: money and gifts from pharma and device makers. Filter by state, NPI, company, amount. Public data.
- [Liquor License Leads: New Applications in NY, TX, MO](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/state-liquor-license-new-applications.html): New and pending liquor license applications from official NY, TX and MO open data: dates, addresses, venue type and a lead score for openings.
- [NIH Research Grants Awarded Tracker: NIH Grants Scraper](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/nih-research-grants-awarded.html): Search NIH research grants and NIH awards by year, state, institute or topic: organization, award amount, award date, abstract snippet, funding score.
- [IRS Nonprofit 990 Financials and Health Score API](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/irs-nonprofit-990-financials.html): Search US nonprofits and get Form 990 revenue, expenses, net assets and a financial-health score per organization. Free ProPublica data, no login.
- [FDA Recalls API: Drug Recalls, Device and Food Recalls](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/fda-recalls-enforcement-reports.html): Drug recalls, medical device recalls and food recalls from FDA: class I/II/III, firm, reason, dates, distribution and severity score. Public openFDA data.
- [CPSC Recalls API: Consumer Product Recall Data & Hazards](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/cpsc-consumer-product-recalls.html): US consumer product recall data: products, hazards, remedy, units sold, injuries, contact and a severity score. Public CPSC data, no login.
- [NHTSA Vehicle Recalls Lookup: Car Recalls by Model, Year](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/nhtsa-vehicle-recalls-lookup.html): Car recalls and vehicle safety recalls from NHTSA by make, model and year: component, consequence, remedy, park-it flags, severity score. No VINs.
- [Federal Register Rules and Notices Monitor: Regulatory API](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/federal-register-rules-notices-monitor.html): Track new federal rules, proposed rules and regulatory notices from the Federal Register: agencies, comment deadlines, effective dates, impact score.
- [ClinicalTrials.gov New Studies Tracker: Clinical Trials API](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/clinical-trials-new-studies-tracker.html): Track new clinical trials posted on ClinicalTrials.gov by sponsor, phase, status or condition: enrollment, dates, countries, opportunity score. No login.
- [EPA ECHO Violations API: Facility Compliance Data](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/epa-echo-facility-violations.html): EPA air, water and hazardous waste violators: facility, NAICS, quarters in noncompliance, penalties and a risk score. Public EPA ECHO data, no login.
- [SEC Company Financials from XBRL (10-K, 10-Q)](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/sec-company-financials-xbrl.html): Annual and quarterly company financials from SEC XBRL: revenue, income, cash flow, margins, growth and a fundamentals score. Tickers in, rows out.
- [FMCSA Authority Suspension Alerts for Carriers](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/fmcsa-authority-revocation-alerts.html): FMCSA operating authority suspension notices for US motor carriers with effective date, risk score, phone, email and fleet size. Public data.
- [Nursing Home Ratings, Fines & Penalties](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/cms-nursing-home-ratings-penalties.html): Nursing home star ratings, fines, abuse flags and special focus status from CMS Care Compare, with phone, beds and a risk score. No login.
- [Restaurant Health Inspection Scores & Violations](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/restaurant-health-inspection-scores.html): Restaurant inspection scores, grades, critical violations and new-restaurant signals for NYC, Chicago, Seattle area and more. Public data, 0-100 risk...
- [SEC 13F Institutional Holdings Tracker](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/sec-13f-institutional-holdings.html): Track what hedge funds and institutions own: 13F-HR positions with CUSIP, value, shares and quarter-over-quarter change. Free SEC EDGAR data, no login.
- [Congress Bills Tracker: Recent US Bills and Status](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/congress-bills-tracker.html): Track recently updated US House and Senate bills: sponsor, latest action, status, policy area, subjects, cosponsors and committee. Free public data, no...
- [USDA Organic Certified Operations: New Certification Leads](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/usda-organic-certified-operations.html): Find newly certified USDA organic farms, handlers and processors: certifier, scopes, products, status date and state. Public Organic INTEGRITY data, no...
- [EU Company Registry API: KYB Lookup, Pay per Result](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/eu-business-registry-search.html): Pay-as-you-go EU company lookup and new-company feed from official registers (FR, NO, FI). KYB checks with legal form, status and source links.
- [EU Public Tenders API: TED Search + Alerts](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/eu-ted-tenders-monitor.html): Pay-as-you-go EU public procurement search from the official TED API. Filter by CPV, country, buyer; get deadlines, values, winners.
- [UK House Sold Prices API: Land Registry Data, Pay per Result](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/uk-land-registry-sold-prices.html): Pay-as-you-go UK sold house prices from HM Land Registry open data. Search by postcode or town, get median prices, and monitor new sales.
- [UK Sold Prices + EPC Rating API: Land Registry Data](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/uk-property-sold-prices-epc.html): Pay-as-you-go UK sold house prices joined to EPC energy ratings, floor area and price per m2. Search by postcode or town, monitor new sales.
- [Brazil CNPJ Lookup API: Company, Partners, CNAE](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/brazil-cnpj-company-lookup.html): Bulk Brazil CNPJ lookup with 56 fields: status, CNAE, partners (QSA), address, capital and Simples. No login, pay per company.
- [Open jobs from Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby career pages](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/ats-open-roles.html): Companies host jobs on ATS boards with different APIs per vendor.
- [Jobs from any Workday career site](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/workday-jobs-scraper.html): Workday sites share a platform but each has its own tenant URL.
- [LinkedIn public job listings without a login](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/linkedin-public-jobs.html): LinkedIn job search is hard to export without an account or cookies.
- [Hiring velocity signals: company growth from job posts](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/hiring-velocity-signals.html): Hiring velocity signals: Give company names. Each run finds the careers source and returns open roles, new roles in the last 7 and 30 … $4 per 1,000 company signals on the free plan.
- [Remote jobs from 6 job boards in one deduped table](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/remote-jobs-aggregator.html): Remote jobs are spread over many boards, each with its own format, and the same job is often posted on three of them.
- [Hiring Signal Bundle: Open Roles, Trend & Salary per Company](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/hiring-signal-bundle.html): One row per company: open roles, new roles 7/30d, hiring trend, department mix, top roles with links, salary and a 0-100 hiring score. No login.
- [Salary Benchmark Data: Pay Ranges by Role From Job Posts](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/salary-transparency-index.html): Salary percentiles by role, seniority and location from pay-transparent Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby job posts. Sample size, top payers, job links, monitor.
- [Visa Sponsorship Jobs Scraper for Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/visa-sponsorship-jobs-scraper.html): Find job postings that mention visa sponsorship on Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby boards. Flags sponsors or not, with the evidence sentence. No login.
- [Page-level technical SEO audit as data](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/technical-seo-page-audit.html): Spreadsheet audits mix manual checks across many pages.
- [Every URL in a sitemap, with an optional broken-link check](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/sitemap-link-inventory.html): Before a migration you need the full URL inventory.
- [What is this website built on?](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/website-tech-stack-detector.html): Checking sites one at a time in a browser extension does not scale to a list.
- [WHOIS/RDAP, DNS, SSL and security headers in one call](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/domain-intelligence-lookup.html): Domain facts live in four different tools.
- [Hacker News, npm and PyPI signals for developer-tool teams](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/developer-signals.html): You need to know where your tool is being discussed and adopted.
- [Google Search Results Scraper: Real URLs, Sitelinks, PAA](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/google-search-results-scraper.html): Scrape Google SERPs to JSON/CSV: organic results with real URLs, ads, People also ask, related searches. Any country, date filters. Empty pages free.
- [Competitor Ads Checker: Google + Meta Ad Library](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/ad-footprint-by-domain.html): Is a company advertising? Per domain: Google Ads Transparency + Meta Ad Library ad counts, formats, dates, samples, score. No login.
- [PyPI Package Stats and New Releases Tracker](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/pypi-package-stats-releases.html): Track PyPI packages: latest version, release dates, release cadence, download counts and an activity score. Public PyPI API, no login.
- [SSL Certificate Subdomain Finder: Subdomains from CT Logs](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/ssl-certificate-subdomain-finder.html): Find subdomains of any domain from public SSL certificate transparency logs. First seen, expiry, issuer and a freshness score per hostname. No login.
- [npm Package Download Trends and New Versions API](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/npm-package-download-trends.html): Track npm packages: weekly and 30-day downloads, trend percent, latest version, publish date, deprecation and a momentum score. Public npm APIs, no login.
- [WordPress Plugin Stats: Installs, Updates, Health Score](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/wordpress-plugin-directory-stats.html): Read WordPress.org plugin stats: active installs, ratings, downloads, last update, tested-up-to version and a health score that flags abandoned plugins.
- [News alerts for companies and keywords as data](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/company-news-monitor.html): News alerts email you; they do not feed a spreadsheet or Slack.
- [Apple App Store reviews and ratings by country](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/app-store-reviews.html): Reading reviews in the app store does not export.
- [Facebook and Instagram ads from the Meta Ad Library](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/meta-ad-library.html): The Meta Ad Library is public, but it has no simple export of ads by keyword or advertiser.
- [YouTube video scraper: views, likes, dates and tags as a table](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/youtube-video-scraper.html): YouTube video scraper: Give search terms, channel or playlist URLs, hashtags or video URLs. - [TikTok profile scraper: followers, posts and engagement](https://mamoo85.github.io/open-data-actors/tiktok-public-profile-scraper.html): Latest posts and profile stats for public TikTok accounts: views, likes, comments, shares, hashtags, music and engagement rate. $2.50 per 1,000 results on the free plan.
